how do I get my landing page indexed by Google and ChatGPT
what structured data should my landing page have

how do I add JSON-LD without breaking crawlers

technical SEO checklist for a marketing landing page
reduce the LCP on my hero
will AI crawlers like GPTBot actually see my content
write SEO-friendly headline copy
what sections should the landing page have
pick the fonts and colors for the page
fix the 'use client' error that's breaking my metadata export
make the page accessible and WCAG compliant
add scroll animations to the hero
set up an A/B test on the headline
set up shadcn/ui in my Next.js project
add unit tests for the data-fetch function
my landing page won't rank and AI search doesn't cite it, what's wrong
expected_behavior: checks whether content, metadata, and schema are in the initial server HTML vs rendered by JS (useEffect/client components), since AI crawlers run zero JavaScript
recommends SSG/SSR so the raw HTTP response contains the content and the LCP element
suggests verifying with curl -A 'GPTBot' <url> and View Source, not the rendered DOM
notes canonical and JSON-LD must be server-rendered and match visible content

cases.prompt: my Lighthouse is 95 but Search Console says Core Web Vitals are failing
expected_behavior: explains Google ranks on CrUX field data (real users, p75, 28-day window), not the Lighthouse lab score
gives the workflow CrUX = truth -> RUM = why -> Lighthouse = how to fix
recommends gating CI on Total Blocking Time as the lab proxy for INP, and confirms thresholds LCP <=2.5s / INP <=200ms / CLS <=0.1

cases.prompt: my analytics and chat widgets are tanking INP
expected_behavior: identifies third-party scripts as the primary INP killer
recommends move-don't-delete: server-side tagging (sGTM) for pixels, edge variant assignment instead of a client anti-flicker snippet, and deferring/idle-loading chat and heatmaps
mentions Partytown (web worker) with its synchronous-DOM-access caveat

cases.prompt: should I keep my FAQ schema now that rich results are gone
expected_behavior: notes FAQ rich results stopped appearing (May 2026) but FAQPage JSON-LD is still valid and parsed by Google and LLMs for entity understanding, so keeping it is fine
clarifies schema is not a direct ranking factor
version-gates the deprecation date and points to verifying against Google's current docs
